LanguageData.CC_Adv_PlannedLamps: Planned {0} lamp(s) where the rooms were dark.
LanguageData.CC_Adv_PlannedLamps_None: No lamp was needed, or there was no free spot on the walls for one.
LanguageData.CC_Adv_MissionDue_Detail: Still short: {0}. It's due in {1}, and whatever isn't ready then fails the mission and the goodwill it would have earned.
LanguageData.CC_Adv_World_SickDetail: Sickness is spreading through the region, and illness at home is likelier while it lasts. The colony is short of {0}. It has about {1} left to run.
LanguageData.CC_Adv_World_Sick_Bed: a bed kept for the sick
LanguageData.CC_Adv_World_HungerDetail: The region is going hungry, and the colony has food for about {0} days. Traders will have little to sell until it passes. {1}
LanguageData.CC_Adv_World_HungerHelp: Grow, hunt and gather what you can now, and preserve what won't be eaten soon.
LanguageData.CC_Adv_World_HungerLocusts: The swarm strips any open field it passes over: harvest what's ripe now. Roofed fields and greenhouses are safe.
LanguageData.CC_Adv_CampWaiting_Title: The camp ({0}) is waiting on an answer
LanguageData.CC_Adv_CampWaiting_Closing: "{1}" has {2} left. Unanswered by then, the camp ({0}) takes the default answer.
LanguageData.CC_Adv_CampWaiting_Waited: "{1}" has waited more than a day, and the camp ({0}) is still waiting to hear.
LanguageData.CC_Adv_DecreeCost_Detail: {0} against it and {1} for it: the moods it stirs add up to {2} across the colony. It runs another {3}. If what it does no longer matters more than that, lift it from the Decrees page.
LanguageData.CC_Adv_DecreeCost_Again: Enacted again so soon after the last time, it weighs on people more.
LanguageData.CC_Adv_Office_Physician: Unwell or hurt: {0}. With a physician, everyone heals a little faster, and the wounded are tended more skilfully.
LanguageData.CC_Adv_Office_Reeve: The harvest is coming in, and nobody walks the fields as reeve. With one, every harvest brings in a little more.
LanguageData.CC_Adv_Office_Keeper: {0} is close, and nobody keeps the colony's days.
LanguageData.CC_Adv_Office_Best: {1} would make the best {0} of those here (competence {2}). Appoint them from the Decrees page, or wait for the election.
LanguageData.CC_Adv_CalPrep_Detail: {0} is kept as {1}, and {2}. See to it today, keep the day another way, or let it pass from the Calendar page.
LanguageData.CC_Adv_CalPrep_Feast: there aren't meals enough in store for everyone to sit down to
LanguageData.CC_Adv_CalPrep_Hunt: nobody who hunts has a bow or a gun to hunt with
LanguageData.CC_Adv_CalPrep_Bonfire: there's no campfire, and too little wood to lay one
LanguageData.CC_Adv_PromiseBreaking_Detail: Less than a day left on what the council promised. Grant it now, or say honestly that it can't be done:
LanguageData.CC_Adv_StorageRoof_Title: {0} stack(s) stored under the open sky
LanguageData.CC_Adv_StorageRoof_Detail: {0}, and what's stored out in the weather loses its condition day by day: wood, cloth, leather, tools. A roof over the stockpile, or a storeroom, keeps it.
LanguageData.CC_Adv_WinterStores_Title: The stores won't keep through the winter
LanguageData.CC_Adv_WinterStores_Detail: There's food for about {0} days that will spoil, and only {1} days' worth that keeps, for a winter of some {2} days too mild to freeze it. Before it turns: {3}.
LanguageData.CC_Adv_WinterStores_Smoke: smoke the meat in the smokehouse
LanguageData.CC_Adv_Firewood_Title: Not enough firewood for the winter
LanguageData.CC_Adv_Firewood_Detail: The colony's {0} fire(s) and torch(es) will burn about {1} logs between now and spring, and there are {2}. Cut wood while the trees can still be reached.
LanguageData.CC_Adv_DoctorBackup_Detail: If {0} is hurt or ill, nobody else is set to tend them, or anyone else. {1} could doctor (Medicine {2}): set them to it in the Work tab, even at a low priority.
LanguageData.CC_Adv_DoctorBackup_DetailNobody: If {0} is hurt or ill, nobody else here can tend the wounded. Keep {0} out of the worst of the fighting, and look for a second doctor among newcomers.
LanguageData.CC_Adv_BedsDark_Title: {0} bedroom(s) where the beds lie in the dark
LanguageData.CC_Adv_BedsDark_DetailWall: No light reaches the beds there. {0} on the wall would light them without taking any floor.
LanguageData.CC_Adv_BedsDark_Detail: No light reaches the beds there. {0} would light them.
LanguageData.CC_Adv_NoSeat_Title: {0} people ate without a table today
LanguageData.CC_Adv_NoSeat_Detail: {0} ate standing or on the floor in the last day, though the dining rooms have {1} seats. The table was too far from where they were, or every seat was taken at the busy hour. A small table and chairs near the fields or the workshops, or a few more seats, would help.
LanguageData.CC_Adv_Noble_Title: {0}'s bedroom falls short of the title ({1})
LanguageData.CC_Adv_Noble_Detail: As {1}, {0} expects more of their bedroom: {2}.
LanguageData.CC_Adv_Noble_Upgrade: Upgrading the room plans what's missing where it stands.
LanguageData.CC_Adv_Noble_New: The room is too small to upgrade: {0} would give them the space.
LanguageData.CC_Adv_KitchenOutgrown_Detail: {3} cooks share {0} stove(s), and only {2} meals are in store for {1} mouths: the cooks wait their turn while the food runs short.
LanguageData.CC_Adv_KitchenOutgrown_Plan: {0} has room for the stoves the colony needs.
LanguageData.CC_Adv_KitchenOutgrown_NoPlan: A second stove beside the first would let two cooks work at once.
LanguageData.CC_Adv_FreezerOutgrown_Detail: {0} of its {1} storage spots are taken, and {2} pieces of food that spoils lie out in the warm.
LanguageData.CC_Adv_FreezerOutgrown_NoPlan: A second cold room, or the freezer's walls moved out, would hold it all.
LanguageData.CC_Adv_DiningCramped_Title: The dining room is cramped for {0} people
LanguageData.CC_Adv_DiningCramped_Detail: Its space is {0} for the {1} who eat there, and a cramped room weighs on everyone in it.
LanguageData.CC_Adv_DiningCramped_NoPlan: Moving a statue or a spare table out, or knocking through a wall, would give them room.
LanguageData.CC_Adv_Workshop_Detail: There are {0}. Work goes slower in the dark, and standing at a bench all day wears on comfort. Upgrading the room plans what's missing; "Plan chairs, lamps" puts a chair on each empty work spot and hangs lamps where it's dark.
LanguageData.CC_Adv_Workshop_NoChair: {0} bench(es) with no chair at the work spot
LanguageData.CC_Adv_Prison_Detail: Missing: {0}. Unhappy prisoners break, fight and try to escape, and join less willingly. Upgrading the cell plans what's missing.
